summary: Verified sequentially with no critical errors or gaps. The statement is self-contained. The displayed splittings establish admissible exact sequences, and the complete arrow checks establish that X_1 and X_t are upper triangular S_2 objects. The components of F are invertible, lower triangular chain maps satisfying every naturality equation. For each assignment, the image objects are valid split S_2 diagrams and every component image is an isomorphism. Nevertheless, the square for beta would require id_H = (1/4)id_H, which fails because 3/4 is nonzero in Z_(3). After arXiv theorem search returned unrelated results, the block conventions, triangular restrictions, assignments and claimed simplicial functors were verified directly against [arXiv:1503.07966v8, Conventions 11, Definition 12 and Lemma 13(III)](https://arxiv.org/html/1503.07966v8). The counterexample therefore establishes the claimed failure of both strict degree-two functor assignments. It does not establish that Theorem 5 is false. No hard-prohibition violation or internal fact dependency was found.
